name: Standard Work Permit (Act No. 19 of 2006, LMRA-administered)

requirements.blocker_text: Employer-sponsored job offer, applied for via LMRA's Expat Management System (EMS), tied to the employer's Commercial Registration (CR).

sources.title: Labour Market Regulatory Authority (LMRA), Bahrain -- work permit: employer-sponsored via Expat Management System, tied to employer CR; fees BHD 97.5 (6mo)/195 (1yr)/390 (2yr) service fee + BHD 5 admin + BHD 30 job-ad fee (overseas hires) + BHD 90 per dependent; processing 3 working days (in-country) / 21 working days (overseas)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Bahrain). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 LMRA sourced for the core mechanics. GAP, DISCLOSED NOT FABRICATED: Bahrain's 'Bahrainization' system pairs sector-based minimum Bahraini-employment percentages with a monthly per-expat-permit fee (commonly reported around BHD 300+/month) rather than a hard quota-block like Saudi Arabia's Nitaqat -- this flexible, pay-to-exceed-your-ratio structure was only tier-3/4 sourced (HR-vendor content) in this build and could not be confirmed against lmra.gov.bh directly; no specific percentage or fee figure is asserted here. pr_after_months (60) and citizenship_after_months (180, the 15-year Arab-national naturalisation track) are cross-referenced from bh_permanent_residence.json and bh_citizenship_naturalisation.json, not independently sourced here -- the actual applicable naturalisation period depends on whether the applicant is an Arab national (15yr) or not (25yr).
